name: hw-title
title: Handwritten Title
description: Handwritten display text with a word-by-word highlight sweep, a seeded squiggle underline that matches the text width, and a hand-drawn boil.
useWhen: A short motivational line, caption or title that should feel written by hand over footage or a dark board.
You want the words to light up in reading order and finish with an underline.
avoidWhen: The text is a long paragraph: this is a one-to-two-line title.
You want letters written stroke by stroke: use handwrite or handwriting-text.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Text
variables.description: The handwritten line. It wraps on a narrow frame.
variables.default: shine like the star you are

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels; it shrinks on a narrow frame.

variables.label: Ink
variables.description: Color of the text once the highlight has passed.

variables.label: Highlight sweep
variables.description: Words light up one after another.

variables.label: Underline
variables.description: Draw a squiggle under the text.

variables.label: Boil
variables.description: Jitter the whole line a little every third frame, like a hand-drawn loop.

variables.label: Boil amount
variables.description: How far the line jitters, in pixels.

variables.label: Seed
variables.description: Changes the squiggle and the jitter pattern.
